SmartClass - System Architecture

Three clients, one FastAPI backend that holds all rules, PostgreSQL + pgvector, and the simulated UM SPeCTRUM (Moodle).

Student app
React Native + Expo SDK 54
Android / iOS (Expo Go)
attendance, face enrolment,
AI assistant

Lecturer app
same Expo code on phone
and in a browser (Expo web)
admin area: browser only

Camera device client
Raspberry Pi camera or webcam
detects faces locally,
sends only face crops

API routers
REST + JWT roles
(student / lecturer / admin)
WebSocket /ws live events

Background loops
session scheduler, Moodle sync,
attendance sync, materials sync,
low-attendance alert, crop cleanup

Attendance services
sessions, 4 statuses, overrides,
flags, reports, CSV export,
read interface for Module 7

Moodle client
token login, course + enrolment
sync, mod_attendance write,
material download

Face services
InsightFace buffalo_sc (CPU),
3-frame voting, card check
with RapidOCR (local)

AI assistant (services/kb)
parse, chunk, embed (bge-small),
hybrid search, cited answers,
study tools, trends

PostgreSQL 16 + pgvector
Docker, port 5433
21 tables, face + text vectors

Moodle 4.5 (simulated SPeCTRUM)
Docker, own compose file
accounts, courses, materials,
mod_attendance
All backend parts read and write PostgreSQL (dashed arrow).

SmartClass - Module Diagram

8 modules from the proposal. Yew Sing builds M1, M3, M4, M8; Shino builds M2, M5, M6, M7. Arrows show what one module uses from another.

M4 Face Recognition
camera devices, recognition,
flags, feedback events

M3 Attendance Management
sessions, statuses, overrides,
reports, Moodle sync

M1 User Management
Moodle login, accounts,
PDPA consent, face enrolment

M8 AI Learning Assistant
cited Q&A over materials,
study tools, trends

M6 AI Quiz
uses retrieval (FR-814);
quiz lock for chat

SmartClass - Class Diagram (domain model)

SQLAlchemy models in backend/app/models (main attributes). Lines show multiplicity (many - one).

Not drawn as lines
Student 1-* FaceConsent, FaceEnrolment, FaceEmbedding, AttendanceRecord, AttendanceFlag;
Course 1-* KbMaterial, AiChatSession; User 1-* overrides and flag decisions.
Vertical neighbours in a column are linked through the student or session named on the line.

SmartClass - Class Diagram (services)

Service modules in backend/app/services (Python modules drawn as classes, main public functions). Dashed arrow = imports and calls.

Not in the arrows
Routers (backend/app/routers) call these
services; routers/device.py uses
device_service to check X-Device-Key.

pages.title: Activity: face attendance for one class

shapes.text:
SmartClass - Activity: face attendance for one class

Modules 3 and 4. Scheduled session, recognition with voting, student flag, lecturer review, close, Moodle sync.
Detect faces in each frame (on the device)
POST face crops to /device/faces with the device key
Record Present (before cut-off) or Late; first match wins
Review flag with the closest crop: confirm or reject
Class ends: close session, unmarked students become Absent
Send statuses to mod_attendance; retry with backoff; re-sync after override

SmartClass - Activity: face self-enrolment

Module 1 (FR-109 to FR-117). The card check runs locally (RapidOCR + InsightFace); no photo is kept after a decision.
Read and accept the PDPA consent (current version)
Take guided selfies and a photo of the UM matric card
Show retake message; after 2 tries allow 'submit anyway'
OCR matric + name, selfie consistency, selfie vs card face
Status rejected: photos deleted, student may retry

SmartClass - Activity: AI assistant question

Module 8 (FR-805 to FR-809). Answers are grounded in the course's own Moodle materials.
Assistant tab: pick a course, type a question
Follow-up? Rewrite it as a standalone query
Hybrid search: pgvector meaning + full-text keywords, top passages
Answer from the passages with numbered citations; label the topic
Remove LaTeX, renumber citations 1, 2, 3, save the answer
Tap a citation: open the file at that page

SmartClass - Navigation: student app

mobile/student/src/navigation/AppNavigator.jsx. One native stack per tab. Purple = Shino's module. The 'attendance recorded' banner shows over every tab.
Bottom tab bar (side bar on wide web screens)

SmartClass - Navigation: lecturer app (phone + browser)

mobile/lecturer/src/navigation/AppNavigator.jsx. Lecturers get the first five tabs; an admin signs in on the web and gets only the Admin tabs (a phone shows 'use a browser').
Bottom tab bar (side bar on wide web screens)

SmartClass - Wireframes (key screens)

Simplified mock-ups of the built screens (labels taken from the code). Real screenshots go in the report (T104).
Assistant: Boundary value analysis tests values at the edges of each input range ... [1] [2]
Citation chips: [1] Lecture 5.pdf p.12 [2] Tutorial 3.pdf p.2 (tap = open page)
